name: Can I install crown molding myself, or should I hire a pro?

mainEntity.name: Can I install crown molding myself, or should I hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional installer is usually the better choice if your rooms have uneven walls, vaulted ceilings, tight corners, or you want a seamless painted finish. DIY can work for small, simple rooms, but crown molding mistakes are expensive because bad cuts and gaps are very noticeable once the trim is up.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is possible for simple rooms, but a pro is safer for uneven walls, vaulted ceilings, and complex corners.
